title: Two-Device Membership, Transport, Presence & Reconnect
selected_by_owner: 2026-09-23 owner-approved PCV strict order; PCV-03 selected automatically after verified PCV-02 closeout.

selection_basis.reason: PCV-02 completed the durable single-user Character/Campaign/World/Scene and Pixel2D foundation and its approved strict_successor is PCV-03.

objective: A Windows host and Android client can join the same campaign/session as distinct subjects, exchange player-safe projections and commands, disconnect/reconnect without duplicate resolution, and retain membership/role continuity.
acceptance: Implement the currently-placeholder session-protocol transport boundary and the minimal signaling/handshake path needed for real devices.

Preserve the canonical local-capable host-authoritative architecture: direct/manual signaling is the zero-service baseline; optional signaling/TURN/relay remains replaceable and is activated only if required for cross-location reliability.
Invitation/join, stable subject/device continuity, presence, ordered events, idempotency, resume tokens/checkpoints, authority epoch and hidden-before-publication filtering are real runtime behavior.
Android<->Windows cross-device evidence is produced from installed builds, not an in-process synthetic test.
boundaries: Preserve PCV-01/02 real product shell, SQLite/local-first persistence, packaged Library, durable Character/Campaign/World/Scene owner state, SMB-08/09 product data and Pixel2D asset foundation.
Use the existing session/authority/continuity contracts and converge missing transport seams; do not create a parallel multiplayer authority model.
Direct/manual signaling remains the zero-service baseline. Optional signaling/TURN/relay stays replaceable and must not become a blocking paid-provider dependency.
Distinct subjects/devices, hidden-before-publication filtering, idempotency and reconnect continuity must remain explicit authority concerns.
PCV-04+ remain unauthorized until PCV-03 closes and successor selection occurs.
Do not activate public/store release, production credentials, paid providers or commercial scope merely to satisfy PCV-03.
Invitation/join, presence and reconnect controls must be fully usable from phone; PCV-MOBILE-01 applies and no PCV-03 action may be desktop-only.
next_action: Install the repaired exact-head PCV-03 Windows and Android packages built from 97fe6667449d6e5c5ab7de3f31a34f4fe8ffb930 on two separate physical devices and repeat the private invitation/response connection proof. This candidate adds bounded connection failure handling and STUN-assisted direct address discovery while preserving manual WebRTC/direct peer-to-peer session traffic. If Connect player still fails, capture the visible status/error from both devices before any further packaging. PCV-04 remains unauthorized.

Replacement head 97fe6667449d6e5c5ab7de3f31a34f4fe8ffb930 adds bounded connection establishment and STUN-assisted direct discovery, passed exact-head Linux/Windows/deterministic validation run 36043953687, and package run 36045022168 produced exact-head artifact 10829267656.
